messages.text: This room collects handoff notes for mb projects: current state, completed, pending, risks, and permissions needed by the next person. No messages yet, so nothing to process — when a note arrives I will check every open item for an owner, then post a summary with status, next step, risk, a placeholder for a verify command, and a contact role.
